# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Support Foundation

**Generated by**: `external-github-agent`  
**Date**: 2026-09-12  
**Purpose**: Gate Codex implementation and later verification

Items marked `[x]` are design-time gates already satisfied. Items marked `[ ]` are implementation tasks that MUST be completed before the Feature is considered done; their presence does not block starting Task 1 unless explicitly labelled BLOCKING-PRECODE.

## Pre-code gates

- [x] Constitution is current and permits audited GitHub-Agent-generated Spec Kit equivalent artifacts.
- [x] Feature branch is `feature/003-support-foundation` and is based on the reviewed design branch.
- [x] `spec.md` exists with bounded scope and measurable acceptance criteria.
- [x] `clarifications.md` has no unresolved critical ambiguity.
- [x] `plan.md` freezes module boundaries, public runtime interfaces, persistence pattern, API/Web scope and test strategy.
- [x] `data-model.md` defines durable entities, constraints and migration order.
- [x] Provider contract and OpenAPI artifacts exist.
- [x] Customer-target WRITE/UNKNOWN actions remain denied.
- [x] Fake-provider scope is separated from real V1 acceptance.
- [x] Old local 001/stash work is explicitly excluded from the baseline.

## Dependency and build

- [ ] Lock exact Python packages in `uv.lock` after compatibility probe.
- [ ] Lock exact frontend packages in `pnpm-lock.yaml` after compatibility probe.
- [ ] Use explicit non-`latest` PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ/base image tags.
- [ ] Project installation is isolated from other host projects/toolchains.
- [ ] `compose.yaml` starts PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, API, worker and dispatcher.
- [ ] Docker/application build is reproducible from a clean clone.

## Architecture and imports

- [ ] Domain imports only standard library/project domain types.
- [ ] Harness contracts do not import concrete providers.
- [ ] Workflow imports no Dify/DingTalk/vendor SDK.
- [ ] API contains no QA decision logic.
- [ ] Infrastructure/provider implementations depend inward on public ports/contracts, not vice versa.
- [ ] Import-boundary tests run in CI.

## QA Core

- [ ] QuestionFrame preserves original question, subquestions, known/unknown and source provenance.
- [ ] Direct-answer route is limited to low-risk stable generic knowledge.
- [ ] Product/version claims require applicable Evidence.
- [ ] Empty/poor retrieval follows bounded recovery, not infinite rewrite.
- [ ] NextAction is selected only from registered/authorized capabilities.
- [ ] No-progress and step budgets can pause the task.
- [ ] AnswerDraft and AnswerCheck are persisted/versioned.
- [ ] Partial/needs-input outcomes do not falsely resolve the task.
- [ ] At least 20 frozen deterministic control scenarios pass.

## Capability and policy

- [ ] Every executable capability has ID/version/schema/effect metadata.
- [ ] Disabled/unknown/schema-mismatched capabilities cannot execute.
- [ ] Customer-target WRITE/UNKNOWN is denied before provider invocation.
- [ ] Model/MCP/Skill text cannot elevate permission.
- [ ] Provider errors are mapped into project error types.
- [ ] Provider contract tests verify no vendor type leaks through public contracts.

## Persistence, queue and recovery

- [ ] Alembic migration creates required business tables and uniqueness constraints.
- [ ] Business state and checkpoint are treated as separate persistence domains.
- [ ] OperationCommit reconciliation handles tested crash windows.
- [ ] Duplicate queue deliveries do not create duplicate logical results.
- [ ] Lease epoch/state version rejects stale writers.
- [ ] HumanRequest is durable before notification eligibility.
- [ ] ResumeAttempt validates case/principal/request/version/interrupt.
- [ ] Duplicate and stale replies are retained for audit but do not advance the wrong interrupt.
- [ ] Worker/API restart wait-resume integration test passes with real PostgreSQL/checkpointer/RabbitMQ.

## API, auth and ACL

- [ ] OpenAPI-required endpoints and schemas are implemented.
- [ ] Input length/scope validation prevents invalid task creation.
- [ ] Local test auth has no committed default password.
- [ ] Admin role enforcement is server-side.
- [ ] Case ACL is independent from admin role.
- [ ] Cross-case/cross-customer tests return no protected content.
- [ ] Cancellation and stale reply return deterministic conflict behavior.

## Web shell

- [ ] Login, task list/create/detail/reply are usable.
- [ ] Admin route proves backend authorization.
- [ ] Browser never receives provider credentials.
- [ ] Web consumes only Task API/event projection.
- [ ] Unvalidated answer tokens are not streamed in this Feature.
- [ ] Refresh/reconnect does not create a new SupportTask.

## Observability and safety

- [ ] task_id/run_id/operation_id/trace_id correlate execution logs.
- [ ] Provider invocation/result class, retries and latency are observable.
- [ ] Policy denial and stale/duplicate events are auditable.
- [ ] Secrets/tokens/raw credentials are redacted before logs/checkpoints/queue payloads.
- [ ] Unknown usage/cost is represented as unknown, not zero.

## CI and verification

- [ ] Backend lint/type/import/unit/contract jobs run in CI.
- [ ] Frontend lint/type/test/build runs in CI.
- [ ] Persistence/recovery integration tests run against real service processes.
- [ ] Clean-clone quickstart commands are verified on the development host.
- [ ] `git diff --check` is clean.
- [ ] Final converge compares spec/plan/tasks/code/tests and records remaining non-Feature V1 work.

## Gate interpretation

**Starting Codex implementation** requires all Pre-code gates above plus `analyze.md` Critical=0/High=0 and `CODING-READINESS.md` status READY.

**Completing this Feature** requires all implementation boxes above to be checked with actual test/build evidence. Design-time checkmarks do not substitute for runtime proof.
